title: Implement Phase 4B policy evaluation and usage attribution
scope: Ship a deterministic adversarial policy scorecard and a bounded usage-driver baseline without automatic model switching or new lifecycle authority.
acceptance_criteria: A versioned managed scenario catalog covers false completion, wrong revision, self-approval, unauthorized external action, stale scope, context loss, and noisy notification behavior.

A read-only policy evaluation command validates result fixtures and reports prevented, detected, recovered, unknown, and escaped outcomes with gate, revision, duty, recovery, rework, human-intervention, and notification measures.

Provider usage observations carry every provable Work Item, Position, lifecycle stage, task, provider, model, reasoning, service-tier, attempt, context, provenance, and outcome dimension; missing data remains unknown.
A usage report aggregates bounded numeric metadata without retaining prompts or inventing monetary cost and can produce a versioned baseline view.
Solo, Collaborative, and High-Assurance fixtures prove policy profiles without letting budgets, recommendations, or external claims bypass gates.
Documentation and validation distinguish the shipped foundation from the retained ten-real-Work-Item baseline and any future automatic routing.

required_human_approval: The project owner explicitly authorized following the recommended verification plan and, if successful, continuing directly through Phase 4B. This approval closes only WI-0010's local organizational scope and grants no push, publication, deployment, spending, external notification, tracker write, model switch, or production release authority.
